sections.description: Expert Computer Repair WordPress Theme has been designed for computer technicians, who may be working as a freelancer or having an office of their own. This is an easy and ready to use template that will help you make your computer repair business live within a hours or a day or two; with minimal hassles and barriers. All you have to do is download the theme, install it, upload images and information and you’re set. On Expert Computer Repair WordPress Theme you will be able to place all the important information that a potential customer may be looking out for to hire computer repair service. Whether you are a computer repair consultant, computer specialist, an expert in computer, this theme is for you. You can write about expertise you have, types of clients you serve, types of services you offer, brands of computer you have expertise in, this theme gives you scope to showcase all the information you consider important from the point of view of your customer. The theme is easy to manage. You can manage your business online, yourself; share everything about your work, your profile, your experience. You can make changes whenever you want to without any technical skills. When you download the theme you get login access to the Dashboard from where you can change images like uploading new images, making new announcements, changing phone number, address, with a click of a button. The biggest problem for a computer technician to attract business is lack of online presence. The biggest barrier for him/her to build one is finding and hiring the right designer who will do the job at an affordable cost, will include features and functions required for a computer repair shop to work efficiently for its online audience
